scope: Checks handoff integrity and evidence file existence. Does not run tests or prove behavior, deployment, security, or accessibility conformance.

results.reason: Anonymous household matching and reviewed provider updates define the core value.
results.acceptance: Household completes questionnaire, understands uncertainty, edits answers; provider submission becomes public only after admin approval.

results.reason: Responsive navigation, labels, validation, and empty results are present.
results.acceptance: Mobile journey has no horizontal overflow; invalid entries explain corrections; no matches has a useful path forward.

results.reason: Added loading, route/root recovery and explicit data failure states without fictional fallback.
results.acceptance: A failed data request clears listings, exposes retry, and preserves household input; root errors have bilingual recovery.

results.reason: English/Spanish dictionaries and state-preserving language switching exist.
results.acceptance: Dictionary keys match and switching languages preserves questionnaire answers.

results.reason: Privileged operations validate session, membership, role, and database policies.
results.acceptance: Anonymous and unrelated providers cannot mutate data; non-admins cannot approve or self-promote.

results.reason: Added bounded JSON parsing, consistent errors, private API cache controls, request IDs, and retry guidance.
results.acceptance: Malformed JSON returns 400; non-JSON 415; oversized actual streams 413; error bodies and logs omit secrets.

results.reason: Added fail-closed production configuration; partial configuration always fails.
results.acceptance: Production without Supabase rejects data/auth requests unless explicitly opted into a fictional demonstration.

results.reason: Security headers and nonce-based script CSP are configured and exercised on the production build; inline styles remain permitted.
results.acceptance: Framing and object embedding are blocked; CSP permits actual app functionality; API responses are no-store.

results.reason: Versioned migrations, fixture validation, transactional review, and audit trail exist.
results.acceptance: Invalid data fails validation and provider statements do not grant independent verification.

results.reason: Household information stays in memory; a browser regression verifies matching sends only a public data GET and writes no browser storage.
results.acceptance: Household answers and rounded location are not sent to backend or written to browser storage.

results.reason: Automated unit, database, browser, and accessibility tests exist.
results.acceptance: Run the documented commands successfully; test source existence alone is insufficient.

results.reason: CI/dependency-update configuration and local locked checks are present. The private project repository was identified during Git publication, but hosted CI execution and branch-protection evidence remain unverified. The acceptance criterion explicitly requires a CI run.
results.acceptance: Fresh checkout installs locked dependencies and passes typecheck, lint, tests, build, audit, and browser checks in CI.

results.reason: Added a noncached readiness endpoint and sanitized server failure events.
results.acceptance: Health returns 200 only when public data can be read, otherwise 503 without configuration details.

results.reason: Metadata and robots keep fictional directory pages out of intentional indexing.
results.acceptance: Robots disallows crawling and metadata is noindex; this does not replace authorization.

results.reason: Feedback submission and administrator review are present.
results.acceptance: Anonymous report is visible only to admins; network errors do not claim success.

results.reason: All bundled locations are fictional; source research is not field verification.
results.acceptance: Verify a small real service cohort, source provenance, contact, hours, offerings, restrictions and translated content; record who checked each field and when.

results.reason: Live Supabase credentials and a deployed staging environment are unavailable.
results.acceptance: Apply migrations in staging, test anonymous/provider/admin/nonmember roles with real Auth sessions and HTTPS cookies, then run the public workflow against the release candidate.

results.reason: Per-process throttling does not protect multiple instances or direct Supabase RPC access; session lifecycle remains limited.
results.acceptance: Prove shared limits on login, feedback, and changes including direct RPC; test session expiry/revocation and operator-supported recovery; validate proxy origin settings and CSP on staging.

results.reason: A health route and runbook do not configure external monitoring or backups.
results.acceptance: Connect uptime/error alerts to a named owner, configure backup retention and spend alerts, restore to staging and rehearse rollback with recorded recovery times.

results.reason: Automation cannot establish usability or full WCAG conformance.
results.acceptance: Complete keyboard, screen-reader, 200/400 percent zoom, Spanish review, older-phone and slow-network tasks with representative consenting users; fix critical barriers.

results.reason: Real operator identity, support ownership, retention and jurisdiction-specific policy decisions are unknown.
results.acceptance: Name support/security/privacy contacts; approve actual hosting/log/feedback retention and deletion procedures; review operator policies for the launch context and publish accurate contact details.

results.reason: No observed user validation or production capacity evidence supports launch yet.
results.acceptance: Record pilot task success and failure reasons, measure release-candidate performance, capacity and cost, then record go/no-go with each blocker closed and evidence attached.

results.reason: Product outcomes should first be measured through consent-based pilot research.
results.acceptance: Collect completion, comprehension, verified-service accuracy, and successful referral outcomes without retaining household answers or precise location.

results.reason: Fresh per-request nonces authorize framework scripts without script unsafe-inline; production browser checks cover injection blocking, hydration and navigation. Staging proxy validation remains LAUNCH-03.
results.acceptance: Adopt a rendering-compatible nonce/hash CSP, remove unsafe-inline for scripts, and verify navigation and hydration on the release build.

results.reason: Vitest was upgraded to remove critical/moderate test-tool findings. Five high development-only findings remain in the Next ESLint/braces dependency chain; the underlying advisory lists no patched braces version.
results.acceptance: Review actual development/CI exposure and adopt a patched compatible lint dependency chain, or document a reviewed replacement and residual risk; rerun full dependency audit and all quality checks. Do not mistake production-only audit success for a clean full audit.

results.reason: Self-service invitations, password recovery and refreshed sessions improve provider experience after the private pilot.
results.acceptance: Implement verified membership invitations and recovery with expiration, revocation, enumeration resistance, and cross-organization tests before self-service rollout.

results.reason: Billing, subscriptions, carts and payments have no role in this free directory.
results.acceptance: Reassess only if an approved business model introduces money movement.

results.reason: Household accounts, advertising, push/email marketing and social login are unnecessary for anonymous matching.
results.acceptance: Add only for a validated user need with privacy and lifecycle requirements.

results.reason: Offline caches, native packaging and live maps are deferred; stale food-service information can mislead.
results.acceptance: Maintain honest list fallback; require verified routing inputs and freshness design before introducing offline or maps.
